description: Amnesia Haze may actually drive inspiration rather than forgetfulness. This strain makes for a well-balanced, albeit somewhat cerebral high, with an uplifting energetic boost.

Animal Face comes from Seed Junky Genetics, a cross of their Face Off OG cut with an Animal Mints male - Face Off OG bringing pine and fuel, Animal Mints bringing the cookies-and-mint sweetness. It won first place in the indoor category at the 2022 Emerald Cup. The flower is dense and heavily frosted, with chunky overlapping calyxes and rust-orange pistils threading through. Aroma is sharp gas and pine first, then a doughy mint sweetness as you break it up. About RYTHM: RYTHM is Green Thumb's flagship cannabis line, built around cultivar selection and careful post-harvest handling so that what is on the label is what is in the jar. Everything on this menu is grown and packaged in New York by Fiorello Pharmaceuticals in Warwick. Cannabis affects everyone differently, so start low and give it time before going further.

strainNameRaw: Bouket - Bouket Noir - Large Bud Indoor Flower
description: Bouket Noir carries the brand's own name for a reason -- it's their house indica, an in-house selection rather than a licensed genetic, grown indoors and packed as large, intact buds. Commonly described as deeply relaxing: a full-body calm that settles tension and quiets a busy mind, better suited to the end of the day than the middle of it. If you want one jar that does the classic indica job well, with no novelty attached to it, this is Bouket's answer to that -- and the flagship of their indoor lineup. About Bouket: Bouket is a Vireo Health of New York brand launched in 2026 following ACE Venture's majority acquisition of Vireo -- the first minority-owned cannabis brand in New York State to receive MWBE certification. The name nods to Harlem's Prohibition-era jazz underground, when "bouquet" was used as coded language for cannabis; the brand's guiding idea is "give yourself your flowers," framing cannabis as part of intentional living. Cannabis affects everyone differently -- start low and go slow, especially with something new.

strainNameRaw: Bouket - Walkabout - Large Bud Indoor Flower
description: Walkabout traces to a Mr. Nice Seedbank sativa -- the seedbank founded by Shantibaba and Neville Schoenmaker -- built from Thai, North Indian, Haze, Mexican, New Guinean and early Skunk landraces. It's one of the more well-traveled pedigrees in cannabis, with genetics pulled from four continents. Commonly described as uplifting and clear-headed with a calming undertone -- energizing without tipping into racy, and easy to stay productive on. Bouket's indoor-grown version is a modern take on a name that has been passed around the cannabis world for decades. Every plant carrying the Haze name traces to the Santa Cruz hills of the early 1970s, where two growers spent successive seasons layering Colombian, Mexican, South Indian and Thai landraces into one long-flowering line. The equatorial parents set the pace. Haze has been a long-season plant ever since; it ripens late, and a grower builds the room's schedule around it rather than the other way round. This is a sativa out of that family, and it asks for the same patience. Published profiles agree on the nose: bright citrus and sweet ripe fruit in front, with the peppery, incense-like spice of the Haze family underneath. Dank is HPI Canna's in-house label, and HPI grows and processes under its own roof rather than putting a name on someone else's product, which is what lets a late-finishing line like this take the weeks it needs. Grown indoors, sold as flower. About Dank. By Definition.: Dank. By Definition. was founded in 2022 by George Karavias and Edward Kirkham and is the in-house brand of HPI Canna, a cultivator, processor and manufacturer based in Poughkeepsie, in the Hudson Valley. HPI runs plant to product on its own site rather than outsourcing, partners with more than forty farms through its Growers Network, and brings a number of outside labels into the state's legal market alongside its own.

Durban Z is Durban Poison crossed with Zkittlez, and it is one of the more legible crosses on this menu - Durban Poison is a South African landrace descendant known for a clean, terpinolene-driven sativa character, and Zkittlez brings candy-sweet fruit and far better resin production. The result keeps the old-school structure, tall tapering spear-shaped buds with foxtailed tips, while sanding off Durban's sharper, more astringent edge. Aroma is sweet citrus and tropical fruit over a dry, spicy backbone. Commonly described as clear-headed and functional. About Good Green: Good Green exists to put money behind the communities most harmed by the war on drugs. Sales fund grants to nonprofits working across three pillars the brand names on every package: education, employment and expungement. Green Thumb launched the brand in 2021 with a commitment of at least 1.3 million dollars, and Good Green has since awarded hundreds of thousands of dollars in grants. Grown and packaged in New York by Fiorello Pharmaceuticals in Warwick. Cannabis affects everyone differently, so start low and give it time before going further.

The indica effects hit hard between the eyes and lay into the body with each hit. Forbidden Fruit’s deep physical relaxation and mental stoniness make it perfect for dulling minor physical discomfort and discarding stress.
The high will hit you a few minutes after your final exhale, beginning in the head with a notable happy boost that pushes out any bad moods or negative thinking to speak of.
Funky, savory, and relaxing. Garlic Budder is known for spicy garlic + buttery/nutty notes and a vibe that’s euphoric at first, then deeply chill—great for end of day.

Seed Junky Genetics built this one in two moves: Grape Stomper crossed to Cherry Pie, then that pairing bred onto a fourth-generation Wedding Cake selection. Grape Stomper carries Purple Elephant over Chemdawg Sour Diesel, and it is why a plant with this much dessert in its pedigree still comes back to fuel. The breeder's own note on the line is grape flavor with gassy undertones, and the record agrees: concord-grape candy and vanilla cake batter first, a doughy, faintly earthy middle, then a light petrol edge that comes forward once it is broken up. Commonly described as relaxed and unhurried. Leal is Sapphire Farms' flagship flower line, grown in living soil under sunlight at the farm in Newfield, then hand-trimmed. Sun-grown flower finishes on the season's clock rather than a light schedule - the slower, less forgiving route a grower takes for a cultivar chosen for its nose. About Leal: Leal is the flagship flower and pre-roll brand of Sapphire Farms, the farm that grows it, in Newfield. The name means loyal, and the company puts loyalty and honesty forward as its mission, alongside pairing quality cannabis with prices an everyday customer can actually meet. Sapphire says it controls the process from the soil to the final product, working sun-grown plants in living soil, and Leal is where the terpene-rich flower they are proudest of ends up.

Gusherz descends from Gelato #41 crossed with Triangle Kush, a Cookies Fam lineage that also travels under the names White Gushers and TK41. Candied tropical fruit up front, a sour berry snap behind it, and an earthy kush backbone. Commonly described as calm and sociable. Named for the candy it tastes like, and one of the most asked-for profiles on the shelf. About Dolla Treez: a New York cultivator built on one idea, extra value every day. Women owned and operated, grown and packed in state so the price stays honest without the flower getting boring.

La Bomba comes from Compound Genetics - Wedding Cake on one side, Jet Fuel Gelato on the other, dessert married to fuel. Most phenotypes finish deep purple in the leaf under a coat of resin you notice by hand before you notice by nose. Tropical with notes of spice and gas - the Wedding Cake side shows up as weight rather than sweetness. Rich and long-lasting by most reports. Grown, hand-trimmed and jarred by Florist Farms in Cortland. About Florist Farms: one of the first legal cannabis brands sold in New York State, grown in Cortland since 2010. USDA Certified Organic since 2012, solar-powered, and grown, extracted and packaged in-house using regenerative practices.

Nic The Bruiser is a product of parent strains East Side OG and Fire 18 that were crossbred to create this masterpiece. The terpenes that ooze from these trichomes are aromatically therapeutic alone. Nic the Bruiser gives off sweet and floral notes that are pulled together with a fuel-like OG funk. This indica-dominant hybrid offers long-lasting relief worth writing home about. Consuming this strain in larger doses will continue to demonstrate the potency that it beholds; unexperienced consumers should use with caution.

NYC Diesel was bred by Soma in 1997 from Mexican and Afghani stock, and named as an homage to his childhood home after 2001. It took five Cannabis Cup trophies in the early 2000s. Ripe red grapefruit and lime over the fuel note the name promises. Commonly described as bright and talkative. A genuine piece of cannabis history, grown and packed in New York. About Dolla Treez: a New York cultivator built on one idea, extra value every day. Women owned and operated, grown and packed in state so the price stays honest without the flower getting boring.

Wedding Cake is a potent indica-hybrid derived from the cross between Triangle Kush and Animal Mints. This strain delivers relaxing and euphoric effects that deeply calm both body and mind, making it ideal for evening relaxation. Its flavor is rich and tangy with an earthy, peppery undertone, appealing to those who enjoy a complex taste experience. Wedding Cake is especially favored by medical marijuana patients seeking relief from pain, insomnia, and appetite loss. Due to its high THC content, it's advisable for consumers with lower tolerance to approach this strain with mindfulness to fully enjoy its profound benefits.

An elegantly balanced hybrid with a sweet, cream-forward bouquet and subtle dessert nuances. Jokerz #31 is smooth, composed, and consistently terpene-rich from the first opening to the final draw. Grown in deep water culture at Roemer Farms, then carefully dried, cured, and hand-trimmed, it’s a premium everyday indulgence—clean-burning, beautifully aromatic, and unmistakably refined. Our Story Roemer Farms is a family-owned cannabis cultivator nestled in the serene hills of Coeymans Hollow, New York. As a licensed Microbusiness, we take pride in managing every aspect of our process—from seed to sale—to guarantee the highest quality in every harvest. Our flower is cultivated using deep water culture hydroponics, a precise method that enables us to consistently deliver clean, potent, and flavorful cannabis. The outcome: rich terpene profiles, vibrant aromas, and smooth-burning buds that truly represent our craft. At Roemer Farms, we combine artisanal cultivation with innovative techniques, intentionally staying small to maintain our focus on producing premium cannabis with care, integrity, and a strong connection to our Upstate NY cannabis community.

Blue Lobster is an indica-dominant strain born from the potent lineage of Eye Candy and Apples and Bananas. Eye Candy, a cross of Biscotti and The Menthol, is known for its minty aroma and premium GSC effects that induce happiness, creativity, and euphoria. Apples and Bananas, an evenly balanced hybrid, boasts a sweet and fruity flavor profile with a touch of spice, delivering a powerful high that combines euphoria and deep relaxation. Blue Lobster is inherits a unique blend of these characteristics. It offers a potent and long-lasting experience, combining the uplifting and euphoric effects of Eye Candy with the relaxing and potentially arousing qualities of Apples and Bananas.

Summer Collection - Seasonal Release Rich, dessert-heavy terps with a creamy, gassy finish. Deep relaxing effects that settle you in without knocking you out too fast. Perfect way to wind it down—fireside, late night, good people.

Bubba Kush is a deep, old-school classic built around heavy Kush character, rich earthy flavor, and a smooth, grounding experience. Your cut brings together Afghan Kush × OG Kush, two foundational genetics known for dense structure, resin-heavy flower, and that unmistakable earthy-gassy profile. Cannabis portals commonly describe Bubba Kush as a legendary indica-leaning cultivar with tranquil, full-bodied character, while Weedmaps connects its style to Afghan and OG Kush heritage exactly the type of backbone that gives this strain its timeless weight. The aroma opens thick and classic: earthy Kush, sweet hash, dark coffee, and a subtle chocolate-like richness that gives the jar a deep, almost roasted character. Break the buds apart and the profile gets louder — pine, spice, soft citrus, and a heavy herbal funk come forward under that Afghan-style earth. On the inhale, Bubba Kush is smooth and rich, starting with earthy sweetness and subtle cocoa before moving into piney gas and a soft pepper finish. It is not flashy candy flower it is premium comfort with grown-up flavor. Bubba Kush delivers a calm, immersive experience that feels built for slowing the world down. Expect a warm mental ease first, followed by a steady body relaxation that settles in gradually and stays smooth. It is ideal for evenings, quiet sessions, deep music, movies, or that “do not ask me for anything for the next hour” kind of mood. The OG side keeps the profile flavorful and layered, while the Afghan Kush influence gives it that grounded, classic body feel. Kush lovers know the assignment. Visually, Bubba Kush brings that dense, compact bag appeal: chunky buds, rich green tones, orange pistils, and a thick trichome layer that makes the flower look sticky and heavy before you even open it. It carries the look of a true legacy strain not overly colorful, not trying too hard, just loud, resinous, and serious. This is Electraleaf honoring the classics with a premium small-batch finish.

A sweet-n-sour, indica-leaning hybrid with berry citrus fizz and dense, resin-rich nugs that make this one a true farm favorite. Beautiful trichomes sparkle with hues of purple and green, accented by orange pistil hairs. To be enjoyed and indulged!

East Coast Sour Diesel is a complex, gassy cultivar with a long history in the legacy cultivation market. Equal concentrations of caryophyllene, farnesene, and limonene drive the front end with an eye-opening combination of citrus and peppery spice. The powerful top notes combine with pinene and terpinolene to create the petrol sharpness that gives the strain its name. While newcomers should be cautious of the medium-high concentration of THC, this varietal should be good for an active, upbeat, low-stress experience.

Breaking the buds apart reveals deeper layers of sugary pastry, herbal zest, and a soft fuel undertone that rounds out the profile. Flavor follows beautifully tangy citrus on the inhale, creamy dessert notes through the middle, and a smooth, slightly gassy finish that lingers pleasantly.

Flavor stays true with a gassy inhale, earthy OG body, and a thick lingering diesel finish. Motorbreath tends to deliver a powerful, full-bodied experience with a fast cerebral onset followed by a strong physical unwind. Rich, dense, and immersive, this is a strain built for slower evenings, deep sessions, and serious flavor chasers. Visually, the flower is chunky, dense, resin-heavy, and absolutely frosted.

Sharpiez is loud, modern, and built like a marker-stained masterpiece a flavor-heavy hybrid that brings together the clean candy-floral weirdness of Zoap with the sharp, gassy dessert depth of Permanent Marker. Zoap is commonly associated with bright, candy-forward, floral flavor, while Permanent Marker genetics are known for sweet dessert notes, gas, and a bold aromatic finish. One cannabis review listing for Sharpiez also connects the cross to Zoap × Permanent Marker and notes terpenes including limonene, caryophyllene, linalool, and myrcene. The aroma opens loud and unusual in the best way: sweet tropical candy, creamy fruit, floral soap, and a sharp marker-gas finish that instantly gives it attitude. Break the flower apart and deeper notes show up berry syrup, citrus peel, vanilla dough, fresh rubber, and peppery fuel. On the inhale, Sharpiez starts sweet and glossy, almost like candy-coated fruit with a clean floral edge. The exhale brings the Permanent Marker side forward: creamy gas, pepper, and a lingering chemical-funk finish that makes the flavor feel expensive and dangerous. Sharpiez delivers a balanced but expressive experience with a fast mood lift and a smooth mental buzz that feels creative, social, and slightly mischievous. It has that “ideas are moving faster than usual” energy without becoming chaotic. As it settles, the body gets comfortable and relaxed, giving the strain enough smoothness to keep it enjoyable from start to finish. Great for studio sessions, design work, night drives, playlists, or any moment that needs a little weird luxury. Visually, Sharpiez should look as loud as it smells: dense frosty buds, deep green and purple tones, bright orange pistils, and heavy trichome coverage that gives the flower that sugar-dipped exotic look. Sticky, aromatic, and full of personality, this is the type of jar people open twice just to smell again. Sharpiez is not here to be polite it is here to leave a mark.
